A '''copper door''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Crafting Table]] recipes and [[Stonecutter]] recipes for the 8 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Copper Door}} for everything else.
